title: Characteristic quasi-polynomials of truncated arrangements
summary: Given an (affine) integral arrangement $\mathcal{A}$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$, the reduction of $\mathcal{A}$ modulo an arbitrary positive integer $q$ naturally yields an arrangement $\mathcal{A}_q$ in $\mathbb{Z}_q^n$. Our primary objective is to study the combinatorial aspects of the restriction $\mathcal{A}^{(B,\bm b)}$ to the solution space of $B\bm x=\bm b$, and its reduction $\mathcal{A}_q^{(B,\bm b)}$ modulo $q$.
